item.title: A message from the main office:
item.description: Attention students: A reminder that our Physical Education change rooms are now device-free zones. Cell phones, smartwatches, smart glasses, tablets, and other mobile devices are not permitted in the change rooms at any time. Please leave your devices in your locker or follow the directions provided by your teacher. Also, the change rooms are for students who are currently taking a Physical Education or Personal Fitness class. If you are not in one of these classes, please use the student washrooms located elsewhere in the school. These expectations are in place to protect everyone's privacy and safety. Thank you for helping us keep our change rooms safe and respectful for everyone.
